description: Create one XMemo Ledger transaction and backing memory. Requires memory:write; it records a new transaction or reuses a semantic duplicate, and never deletes Ledger records. Use it for a purchase, income, refund, or transfer; use list_ledger_transactions or get_monthly_ledger_summary for reads. amount must be positive; transaction_type defaults to expense; blank transaction_date uses today's UTC date.

agent_id.description: Optional client-supplied agent label for memory attribution.

agent_instance_id.description: Optional stable, non-secret agent instance ID for per-client attribution.

amount.description: Positive transaction amount; zero and negative values are rejected.

bucket.description: Bucket for the backing memory; defaults to private.

category.description: Optional Ledger category, such as food, transport, or electronics.

currency.description: Currency code or label; labels such as yen or RMB are normalized to codes.

device_id.description: Optional client-supplied device identifier for attribution.

device_label.description: Optional human-readable device label for attribution.

item.description: Purchased item, income source, refund, or transfer label.

merchant.description: Optional merchant, payer, payee, or store name.

note.description: Optional note stored with the transaction.

path.description: Memory path; the default follows transaction_type for non-expenses.

payment_method.description: Optional payment method, such as card, cash, Alipay, or WeChat Pay.

project_id.description: Optional exact authorized project ID; stores the transaction in its private scope.

scope.description: Optional authorized scope; must match project_id when both are set.

team_id.description: Optional team attribution within the authorized scope.

transaction_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD transaction date; blank uses today's UTC date.

transaction_type.description: Transaction to create: expense, income, refund, or transfer.

name: add_expense

result.description: Human-readable text or JSON requested by output_json.
